The new specs cover malformed URL, initial creation, and an update with changed contents, but they do not cover the unchanged-content no-op branch, nor do they assert that `topic_embeds` remains a single row for the `embed_url` or that `content_sha1` is persisted/updated (the update test only checks `post.cooked` matches new contents). This is a specific, diff-grounded test gap rather than a demonstrated defect.
